newsitem.title: GERMANY: German debt seen in ranges through early next week.
newsitem.headline: German debt seen in ranges through early next week.

text.p: Bunds are expected to trade in narrow ranges early next week after drifting in a narrow 11 basis point range on Friday.
Traders said light volumes should characterise trade with most unwilling to take new positions before the end of the year.
"There is no reason for this market to move much in either direction," one trader said.
The DTB Bund futures contract was up one basis point in late afternoon trade at 100.67. The 10-year cash Bund was also little changed at 103.16, yielding 5.79 percent.
